title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: mc> tc we435> soundcard> cdwave 44100/stereo/16 bit> traders little helper encoding option 8

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced FOB recording praised for stunning sound and highlight performances of Playing in the Band, China Cat Sunflower and He's Gone, though listener opinions on its fidelity are mixed.
ai_review.review: One reviewer lauds the recording’s clarity—calling it “stunning” and highlighting Playin’, China and He’s Gone as show‑highlights. Another notes that the tape is a Jim Wise FOB captured with Sennheiser 421 microphones and rates it poorly, indicating divergent views on its overall quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives strong praise for song selection and energy, while recording quality is praised by one reviewer but dismissed by another, leading to a balanced mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FOB recorded with Jim Wise's Sennheiser 421 mics; some listeners describe the sound as crisp and detailed, while another reviewer gave it a low rating.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure were provided.
